issues.failure_explanation: The paper defines V = W^{1,1}_0(Ω) for a general uniformly convex N-function φ. For such φ, the energy J(v)=∫φ(|∇v|)-fv may be infinite on W^{1,1}_0, and the variational equation pairs A(∇u)∈L^{φ^*} with ∇v∈L^1, which need not be integrable. The correct space is the Orlicz-Sobolev space W^{1,φ}_0(Ω), as indicated by the example where V=W^{1,p}_0 for φ(t)=t^p/p.

failure_location.quote: we approximate the minimizer of a convex minimization problem over the space $V \coloneqq W^{1,1}_0(\Omega)$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Define V as the Orlicz-Sobolev space W^{1,φ}_0(Ω) (or the appropriate energy space) and adjust the variational formulation accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The minimization problem and variational equation are not well-posed as stated, so the main theorems are not properly formulated.
issues.title: Wrong function space V = W^{1,1}_0 for general N-function
issues.why_classification: The intended space is clear and the correction is standard, but it is a foundational well-posedness issue that must be fixed before the results apply.

issues.failure_explanation: The right-hand side of the enrichment estimate sums only over interior faces. For a CR function that is continuous across all interior faces but has nonzero values at boundary vertices (e.g., on a square split into two triangles, set all boundary face midpoints to 0 and the interior face midpoint to a≠0), the right side is zero. However, E sets boundary vertex values to 0, so v_h - E v_h is nonzero. Thus the estimate is false; boundary face contributions are missing.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add boundary face terms to the right-hand side of the enrichment estimate (or restrict to functions vanishing at boundary vertices).
issues.overall_effect: Lemma confComp is invalid, and all results relying on it (main theorem, a priori estimates, conforming approximation) are unsupported.
issues.title: Enrichment estimate omits boundary face contributions
issues.why_classification: The lemma is false as stated and is a central tool for the main quasi-optimality result; no minor local edit preserves the proof.

issues.failure_explanation: In the bubble integration, replacing ∫_{ω} ∇e_h·curl b by ∫_{ω} ∇(v-e_h)·curl b requires ∫_{ω} ∇v·curl b = 0. Since b only vanishes on ∂ω, this integral equals ∫_{∂ω} v curl b·ν, which is not zero for arbitrary v∈W^{1,1}_0. The proof does not impose conditions on b to make this boundary term vanish.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Choose a bubble function with zero normal derivative on ∂ω, or handle the boundary term explicitly.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma confComp is incomplete, so its estimates are not established.
issues.title: Invalid replacement in bubble integration in Lemma confComp
issues.why_classification: The gap can be repaired by a standard modification of the bubble function, but it is a nontrivial missing argument in a central proof.

issues.failure_explanation: The extra term in Theorem ApproxProperties and its use in Theorem AprioriConf should involve the convex conjugate (φ_{|∇v|})^*, as in Lemma confComp and Lemma Oscillation. As written, the theorem bounds the interpolation error by ∫ φ_{|∇v|}(h|div A(∇v)|), which is false; for harmonic v with div A(∇v)=0 the right side vanishes but the interpolation error is generally positive.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace φ by its convex conjugate (φ)^* in the extra term of Theorem ApproxProperties and in the corresponding steps of the proof of Theorem AprioriConf.
issues.overall_effect: Theorem ApproxProperties is false as stated, and the proof of Theorem AprioriConf incorrectly applies Lemma Oscillation to a non-conjugate term.
issues.title: Missing convex conjugate in Theorem ApproxProperties and its use
issues.why_classification: The correction is local and preserves the intended result, but it changes a formal statement that is otherwise false.

The proof only establishes the bound for v=u (via eq:approxInc). For general v, the statement is false (e.g., take u=0, then the term is zero but the interpolation error of a nonconforming v need not be zero).
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace ∇u by ∇v in the best-approximation term of Theorem ApproxProperties.
